pkgmetadata.longdescription: SolidCraft is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application written in Rust. It provides sketches with a constraint solver, a parametric feature timeline, assemblies and sheet metal, and imports and exports STEP, IGES, 3MF, STL and OBJ. It also includes a headless CLI and an MCP server.
SolidCraft 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源参数化三维 CAD 应用，提供带约束 求解器的草绘、参数化特征时间线、装配与钣金功能，并支持 STEP、IGES、 3MF、STL 和 OBJ 格式的导入导出。它还包含无界面命令行工具和 MCP 服务器。
